mechanism: Berberine inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2C9, potentially increasing methylprednisolone plasma concentrations and corticosteroid effects; both agents may increase infection risk and impair glucose control.
action: Monitor for enhanced corticosteroid effects (hyperglycemia, immunosuppression, hypertension); consider methylprednisolone dose adjustment or increased monitoring if berberine is initiated or discontinued.
